topic: LED Light Color Specification for Vehicle Exterior Lighting System
row_semantics: Each row represents a specific color configuration for an LED light source, identified by a signal number. The rows are organized in a sequential list of predefined colors.

core_entities.name: LED Light Source
core_entities.description: An individual light emitting diode used in vehicle exterior lighting systems.

core_conditions.description: Defines the specific hue and saturation of the light as per CIE 1931 standard.

core_conditions.name: RGB Values
core_conditions.description: Digital values representing the intensity of red, green, and blue components to produce the desired color.

core_outputs.name: Reference Color
core_outputs.description: The visual appearance of the light as displayed in the table's last column.

engineering_interpretation: This table is used to define and verify the color specifications for LED lights in vehicle exterior lighting systems, ensuring that the emitted light matches the required chromaticity and RGB values for various functions such as turn signals, daytime running lights, or ambient lighting.
